description: List the comments on a record, newest first, with pagination.

baseId.description: ID of the Airtable base containing the table.

offset.description: Optional pagination offset returned by a previous list_comments call, to fetch the next page.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of comments to return per page (1 to 100).

recordId.description: ID of the record whose comments to list.

tableId.description: ID of the table containing the record.

name: list_comments
